title: [BUG] C persisted replay record lacks key-generation identifier and window bitmap (spec 02 4.4 binding MUST)
description: Req R-02-072: Persisted replay records MUST bind full public key, opaque key-generation identifier, highest counter, window bitmap, and monotonic record generation under an integrity check. DIVERGENT (C): lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay_persist.c:12-19,94-111,169,286-292 has keyed-BLAKE2b integrity + local/peer pubkey + tx_epoch + per-peer high-water floor (seq+31), restore marks whole window seen (bitmap=0xFFFFFFFF) — conservative/fail-closed but no opaque generation id and no literal bitmap binding. Rust binds all elements under Schnorr-48 (rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs:725-782,1237-1247); Python binds digest chain + bitmap, generation via retired/rekeyed sets (no explicit opaque id). Fix C record layout (cost: record size on STM32WL) or amend spec wording; decision needed on floor-vs-bitmap acceptability.
